description: Rebuild a bloated WordPress site (typically TheGem / WPBakery / Elementor / heavy multipurpose theme) into a lean LiveCanvas + Bootstrap stack while preserving all load-bearing commerce, content, and integration data. Built from the LMF Props ({CLIENT_CODE}.com) reference run.

required.name: intake.json
required.description: Site URL, admin credentials reference (1Password item title), goals (preserve / sell / soft-relaunch / showcase / modernize), and constraints

optional.name: 1password_item
optional.description: 1P item title resolving to wp-admin user/pass; never inlined

optional.name: host_caching_notes.md
optional.description: Operator notes from host (e.g., 1-Click Web Apps) on server-level caching

image_optimization._comment: Mythos image-optimization standard (tools/image-optimize/) framework gate, slice S4. Declares the obligation; it is RECOMMENDED, not required — promotion recommended->required happens ONLY in slice S5 after measured evidence on real creative against the live VPS quota (LEARNING_AND_AUTOMATION_DOCTRINE). status: 'recommended' means the staging_promotion / cutover deploy paths SHOULD run `node tools/image-optimize/cli.cjs optimize-tiered` locally + the shared preflight (tools/image-optimize/preflight.cjs) in WARN mode before building any upload manifest, but a finding does not yet hard-block the deploy.

caps._comment: Optional per-framework byte-cap (max_bytes) override of the tools/image-optimize/config.json policy.tiers defaults, in BYTES. These match the config.json defaults (hero 256000 / content 102400 / thumb 51200). The preflight reads this block via --framework-manifest and feeds it to resolveTiers() as a tiers override. Omit a tier to inherit the config default for that tier. Per-tier max_width is NOT overridden here (build-time resize concern, not deploy-verify concern).

image_optimization.caps_provenance_note: Caps are the kernel-grade convene-synthesis best-practice defaults (tiered 250KB hero / 100KB content / 50KB thumb), NOT yet validated on this operator's live pipeline. Slice S5 will REPOINT caps_provenance + effective_from at the measured-evidence promotion artifact and promote status recommended->required.
